slides.headline: I used to browse for hours. Now AI buys for me.
Google lets Gemini buy from Flipkart
slides.body: In India, Gemini can now search Walmart's Flipkart, pick items, and place orders without you leaving the chat.

slides.headline: You ask, AI does the rest
slides.body: Type 'buy black running shoes under 3000 rupees' — Gemini finds options, compares prices, and checks out if you approve.

slides.headline: Early test, limited to India only
slides.body: Works only on Flipkart, only in India, only for invited users. Orders can still fail or pick wrong sizes.

slides.headline: If it works, shopping changes everywhere
slides.body: No more tabs, filters, or checkout forms. But you lose control — AI picks what it thinks is best, not what you'd choose.

slides.headline: Want AI that shops for you?
slides.body: Follow for AI news that changes how you live, work, and spend.
